coldOverNetwork.about: Back-end B, toy transit field, a fresh browser profile so every tile came from the server (and Mapbox): request to first bent frame with the GPU finished. The benchmark rows in realTiles.bench were served from the browser cache.

realTiles.note: Measured with the earlier 300k vertex budget and 600k worker cache; not rerun since the budget became 5M and the cache 8M. The drawing gates and the census do not depend on either.

bentMapGpu.about: GPU time of one bent frame (u = 1), median of 12, real Streets v8 tiles at Canary Wharf, toy transit field, 3,687,950 vertices shaded, headless Chrome 157 on an Apple M2. Measured twice per setting; the spread between repeats is larger than any difference between settings.
